text: Parse endpoint converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
quote: Parse is Reducto’s foundational endpoint. It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting

text: Extract pulls specific fields into structured JSON matching a user-defined schema, handling OCR and layout detection internally
quote: You define a schema describing the data you need, and Reducto returns values matching that schema, handling OCR, layout detection, and LLM-based field location under the hood.

text: Schema constraints like regex patterns guarantee extracted output matches the specified format
quote: For example, `"pattern": "^[A-Z]{2}-\\d{4}$"` on a string guarantees the output matches.

text: Split identifies which pages hold which sections, using natural-language section descriptions
quote: Split identifies which pages contain which sections of a document. You describe sections in natural language, and Reducto returns the page numbers where each section lives.

text: Classify determines document type from natural-language category criteria before downstream processing
quote: Classify determines what kind of document you are looking at before any downstream processing begins. You specify categories with natural language criteria, and Reducto returns the best match.

text: Classify returns a category label with per-criterion confidence breakdown and timing info
quote: Classify returns a category label, a per-criterion confidence breakdown for every category in your schema, and timing information.

text: Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX files programmatically using natural-language instructions
quote: Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions.

text: Document generation that fills forms, modifies templates, and produces new documents programmatically
quote: Document generation and editing that fills forms, modifies templates, and produces new documents programmatically

text: Multi-step workflows chain classification, parsing, extraction, and editing into a single API call
quote: Multi-step workflows that chain classification, parsing, extraction, and editing into single API calls

text: Build workflows in Studio, test with a citation viewer, then deploy as a Pipeline ID callable from code
quote: Build document workflows by configuring classification, parsing, extraction, and editing steps, test on real documents with the citation viewer, then deploy as a Pipeline ID callable from code.

text: Official CLI gives terminal access to parse, extract, split, classify, and edit for scripting and CI/CD
quote: The Reducto CLI gives you direct terminal access to Reducto's document capabilities: parse, extract, split, classify, and edit. Use it for batch processing, scripting, CI/CD pipelines

text: CLI can parse an entire directory, writing a markdown output file next to each input
quote: For a directory: reducto parse ./documents ... The CLI writes `<filename>.parse.md` next to each input file.

text: MCP server lets agents in Claude, Cursor, VS Code, etc. classify, parse, extract, split, and edit documents without custom code
quote: agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any other Model Context Protocol client can classify, parse, extract, split, and edit documents as part of their reasoning loop, without custom integration code.

text: Offers both a local MCP server for local files and a hosted MCP server for public URLs
quote: choose local MCP for local files and hosted MCP for public URLs.

text: Async endpoints return a job ID immediately for non-blocking long-running parses
quote: client.parse.run_job() ... POST /parse_async ... Job ID (returns immediately)

text: Svix webhooks with cryptographic signing, exponential-backoff retries, and a delivery debugging dashboard
quote: Svix webhooks provide cryptographic request signing, automatic retries with exponential backoff, and a delivery dashboard for debugging. Use Svix for production applications.

text: Webhooks are managed from Reducto Studio, which opens the Svix dashboard directly
quote: In Reducto Studio, go to Webhooks in the sidebar. This opens your Svix dashboard directly.

text: Citations give bounding box coordinates for every extracted field pointing to the source text
quote: Citations tell you exactly where each extracted value came from in the document. When enabled, every field includes bounding box coordinates pointing to the source text.

text: Parsed elements include type, page position, and confidence score
quote: Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score. Parse handles multi-column text, nested tables, forms with handwriting, rotated pages

text: Parse handles multi-column text, nested tables, handwritten forms, and rotated pages
quote: Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score. Parse handles multi-column text, nested tables, forms with handwriting, rotated pages

text: Configurable chunking in the parse response, with variable chunk mode and chunk size
Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries like headers, tables, and figures, sized for embedding models
quote: Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries like section headers, tables, and figures, keeping related content together while creating chunks sized for embedding models.

text: Agentic processing lets you set custom prompts per content scope or enable advanced chart extraction
quote: Use agentic processing with r-1 when your workflow needs a custom prompt for a specific content type or advanced chart extraction.

text: Parse r-1 model does agentic-quality full-page parsing of text, tables, figures, and layout with bounding boxes
quote: Reducto parse r-1 delivers agentic-quality parsing for text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting in one full-page pass, with bounding boxes

text: Tables can be returned in multiple formats that control how merged cells, headers, and structure are represented
quote: Reducto extracts tables from documents and can return them in several formats. The format you choose affects how merged cells, headers, and structure are represented.

text: Dedicated VPC deployment keeps all data and storage in the customer VPC, with processing on Reducto GPUs
quote: All data and storage reside in the customer’s VPC, while ephemeral processing is handled by Reducto’s dedicated GPU infrastructure.

text: Choice of dedicated VPC, hybrid VPC, or fully hosted SaaS deployment
quote: Customers can choose between a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model, and a fully hosted SaaS model, balancing control, cost, and compute performance.

text: Hybrid and air-gapped deployment options are available
quote: With 3B+ pages processed, hybrid and air-gapped deployment options, and SOC 2 + HIPAA compliance

text: Presigned URL upload supports files up to 5GB, bypassing the 100MB standard upload limit
quote: Files over 100MB? Use the presigned URL method which supports files up to 5GB.

text: Presigned S3/GCS/Azure URLs can be passed directly without uploading
quote: Presigned S3/GCS/Azure URL | Skip upload entirely — pass the URL directly

text: Uploads return a reducto:// identifier reusable across Classify, Parse, Split, Extract, and Edit
quote: returning a unique `reducto://` identifier you can pass to any downstream endpoint: Classify, Parse, Split, Extract, or Edit.
